# TMDB metadata fixtures

These are synthetic minimal v3 responses, not a live capture or a claim that
these records are currently complete. Issue #350 supplies the translation and
alias evidence for movie 1765072, movie 680770 and person 2001262. Other credits,
text, dates and media are deliberate test data.

The adapter test composes endpoint responses and replays JSON bytes through an
injected transport. No API key, live TMDB request or database is needed.
